text:
mike: quick sync 1min1 1 recency: Oct-Dec incident rollup. goal: pick owners for recurring themes and set measurable deadlines.
priya: saw the deck update (slide 4) with aggregated counts: thanks.
dan: query shows top recurring buckets: cache-evictions, model-ooms during long sessions, tokenizer edge-cases, db-replica lag, autoscaler flip/flap.
linda: recommend separating true recurrences vs new regressions; otherwise numbers are noisy.
sara: I exported incident counts: 42 total flagged recurring. attached CSV to the doc.
incident-bot: compiled 42 incidents tagged "recurring" (2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31). top: caching 28%, model-oom 19%, db-replica 16%.
mike: propose owners: caching->priya, model-oom->dan, db->alex, tokenizer->linda, autoscale->sara. agree?
priya: agreed. I'll open remediation epic and link PMRs. ETA initial rollout 2026-01-31.
dan: model OOM plan: conservative quant profiles + pin model versions + 1-week long-session stress test on dedicated pool. owner: dan. ETA 2026-01-20.
alex: db replica plan: read-fallback, statement timeouts, better replica lag alerts. ticket JIRA-9812 opened. ETA 2026-02-05.
linda: tokenizer: add corpus fuzz tests, fix whitespace tokenization bug in v4, integrate into CI runner. ticket JIRA-9827. ETA 2026-01-15.
sara: autoscaler flap: root cause looks like burst policy + node preemption. short-term: cap shard growth + increase scale-down cooldown; add alert for scaling variance. I'll canary and monitor. ETA 2026-01-10.
priya: observability add: per-route cache hit-rate, prefix-KV eviction metric, alert when eviction>5% over 5m. cc eng-sre for queries.
dan: interim mitigation for model OOMs: per-session soft token limits and graceful truncation.
mike: I'll add canonical action-item table to the incident tracker with owners, tickets, ETAs, and test plans. drop final ticket IDs by EOD Friday.
alex: JIRA-9812 linked.
linda: JIRA-9827 linked.
sara: will post canary rollout schedule in #eng-oncall and tag oncall leads.
priya: follow-up sync proposed 2026-02-10 10:00 PST (two weeks after last ETA).
mike: target: 50% reduction in recurring incident count vs Q4 baseline by end of Q1; weekly tracking. ok?
all: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: reminder set for 2026-02-10 10:00 PST for follow-up sync.
mike: thanks all, closing thread after I attach ticket links and calendar invite.
